notes.title: Zoom Settings Adjusted, Enjoy the Game with a Wider View
notes.notes:
[b]Zoom Settings Adjusted[/b]

- Experience the game with a broader field of view.

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]

- Improved some of the inconvenient interactions within the game for a smoother experience.

notes.title: Scheduled for an update to version 2.0 in early next year
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce the upcoming 2.0 version update, which will bring significant changes.

[b]1. Expanded View[/b]

I have adjusted the game's zoom settings to provide a wider field of view. However, with the expanded view, there are areas in the map that may appear empty, so I am currently redesigning the map to improve this.

[b]2. Additional Story and Content[/b]

Based on your feedback expressing disappointment over the short length, I will be adding new stories and interesting content.

[b]3. Other Improvements[/b]

* Improved interactions with characters and traps
* Fixes for existing issues and bugs
* Optimization of gameplay flow

notes.title: Resolved a Bug Where the Title Menu Was Not Visible at Certain Resolutions
notes.notes: I have fixed a bug where the menu was not visible at certain resolutions. I apologize for the inconvenience caused. Thank you to those who reported this issue. I will continue to strive to improve the game.

notes.title: Z Button Interaction Bug Fix
notes.notes: I have resolved an issue where interacting with the Z button did not work properly at a certain probability.

notes.title: Slowing Down the Speed of Knives Flying on the Y-Axis
notes.notes: I sincerely apologize for the high difficulty level of the game, which has caused inconvenience to many players. I have recognized that the speed of knives flying on the Y-axis is excessively challenging. Therefore, I am adjusting their speed to provide a more reasonable and enjoyable gaming experience. I promise to continue monitoring the game's balance and make necessary adjustments.

notes.title: Stuck Bug Fixed
notes.notes: I have resolved an issue where the character was getting stuck and unable to move at certain points. I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and will take measures to prevent such an issue in the future.

notes.title: Ending Credits Bug Fixed
notes.notes: I have fixed an issue where the ending credits did not appear at a certain probability. I apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Easing the Difficulty of Knife Trap Sections
notes.notes: The difficulty level of the knife trap sections in our game has proven to be too high, causing many players to struggle. Therefore, i have decided to reduce the difficulty of these traps to provide a better gameplay experience.

notes.title: Save-Related Bug Fixes and Dialogue Adjustments
notes.notes: I have fixed the save-related bugs discovered during gameplay. Additionally, I have made some dialogue more natural. I apologize for any inconvenience caused. Thank you for always enjoying my game.

notes.title: Reducing the Difficulty of the Spinning Circular Saw Blade Trap Section
notes.notes: I apologize for any inconvenience caused. I have lowered the difficulty to allow clearing that section without specific conditions.

notes.title: Urgent Patch: I have added a windowed mode.
notes.notes:
Press Alt + Enter to enjoy the game in your desired screen mode 
Thank you~
